name: Amwell
one_liner: Video therapy and psychiatry visits through Amwell's app or website, billed to one of 55+ health plans or paid per visit.
best_for: People whose health plan or employer covers Amwell visits
Adults who want video psychiatry for medication management
Parents looking for video therapy for a child aged 10 to 17
People who want to pay per visit with no subscription
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People looking for the lowest self-pay price, since prices are not published up front
People who need intensive or inpatient treatment
short_description: Telehealth video therapy and psychiatry, plus urgent care, billed to many health plans or paid per visit.
long_description: Amwell is a telehealth company whose clinicians (Amwell Medical Group) offer video therapy and psychiatry across all 50 states and DC; many health plans and employers also offer Amwell under their own branding. You sign up free, choose a clinician licensed in your state and book a visit; children aged 10 to 17 can see a therapist through a parent's account with consent. Initial psychiatry visits last 45 minutes and follow-ups 15 minutes. Amwell's own pages do not print self-pay prices; a third-party review in October 2026 reported $109 to $142 per therapy session and $292 for a first psychiatry visit, while other reviews report lower figures. In January 2025 Amwell sold its hospital-focused Amwell Psychiatric Care business to Avel eCare but kept therapy, psychiatry and its SilverCloud digital programs in its medical group. No published study of Amwell's own therapy or psychiatry service was found.
patient_summary: You create a free Amwell account with your name, state and birthdate, then book a video visit with a therapist or psychiatrist licensed in your state. You pay your plan's copay if Amwell is covered, or a per-visit self-pay price (reported at about $109 to $142 for therapy and $292 for a first psychiatry visit); there is no subscription.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; about $109–$142/session therapy or $292 first psychiatry visit self-pay
pricing.notes: Self-pay prices from a third-party review (October 2026): psychiatry follow-up $109 for 15 minutes or $169 for 30 minutes. Other reviews report lower prices ($99 therapy, $199 first psychiatry visit). Amwell's own pages do not publish self-pay prices. No subscription or sign-up fee; accepts insurance from 55+ health plans.

privacy.notes: Says it does not sell personal information, but lets third parties use some data to show you tailored online ads (opt-out available); offers deletion requests. Visit records are covered by the Amwell Medical Group HIPAA notice.

seo.title: Amwell: Enterprise Telehealth Platform for Health Systems
seo.meta_description: Amwell provides telehealth psychiatry and therapy covered by most major insurance plans, with appointments often available within days.

faqs.q: Does my insurance cover Amwell psychiatry?
faqs.a: Most major insurance plans cover Amwell, including BCBS, Cigna, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, and many others. Copays are typically $20-75 depending on your plan. Check your insurance portal or call the member services number to confirm telehealth mental health coverage.

faqs.q: How quickly can I see an Amwell psychiatrist?
faqs.a: Amwell psychiatry appointments are typically available within 3-7 days, much faster than traditional psychiatrist wait times of 4-12 weeks. Therapy appointments often have same-week availability. Log in to see real-time availability in your state.

Amwell psychiatrists can prescribe controlled substances where permitted by state law and DEA telehealth regulations. This includes ADHD medications and some anxiety medications. Initial evaluations are required, and ongoing care follows prescribing guidelines.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Amwell and Teladoc?
faqs.a: Both are major telehealth platforms with insurance coverage. Amwell has stronger health system partnerships and is often embedded in hospital systems. Teladoc has broader employer coverage. Both offer similar psychiatry and therapy services. Check which your insurance/employer covers.

primary_uses: Video therapy with a licensed therapist
Psychiatric evaluation and medication management by video
Therapy for children aged 10 to 17 with parental consent

availability.note: All 50 states and DC. Therapy from age 10 (minors through a parent's account). Amwell sold its hospital psychiatric service to Avel eCare in 2025; consumer visits continue through Amwell Medical Group.
